patent.title: 一种用于制备嘧菌酯中间体的催化体系及嘧菌酯的制备方法
assignees: 河北威远生物化工有限公司
patent.family_note: Ordinary CN chemical-process invention (Hebei Veyong Bio-Chemical / mid-tier agrochemical; not software/mechanical already covered, not BYD/Huawei/award-star). Claims azoxystrobin preparation via tetramethyl tertiary diamine + sulfone cosolvent composite catalyst. Do NOT inherit mapping from pre-filing Weiyuan azoxystrobin TC registration PD20121486 (first approved 2012-10-09) or from formulation brands 禾媄/威远多彩. Sibling/other Weiyuan formulation patents (e.g. older 威远生化农药 assignee filings) must not be inherited.

knowledge_origin.description: Public sources confirm Weiyuan inventorship/assignee for this azoxystrobin catalytic-process filing, but do not reconstruct whether it originated as an internal cost/energy-down process track versus a named line retrofit tied to a specific workshop campaign.

technology.problem: Prior azoxystrobin routes relying on copper-salt catalysts or DABCO/azabicyclic catalysts face work-up difficulty, cost, selectivity, and/or cryogenic energy burden (as described in the patent background).
technology.mechanism: Claimed preparation method: 3-(α-methoxy)methylenebenzofuran-2(3H)-one + 4,6-dichloropyrimidine under sodium methoxide with acid scavenger and a composite catalyst (tetramethyl tertiary diamine such as TMEDA/TMPDA + sulfone cosolvent such as DMSO/sulfolane) to intermediate III; then coupling with salicylonitrile under the same composite catalyst class to intermediate II; then KHSO4 demethanolysis to azoxystrobin. Asserted milder temperature window and higher intermediate yields vs DABCO comparative example.
technology.comparison_baseline: Copper-salt catalyzed couplings and DABCO / azabicyclic catalyst systems for azoxystrobin intermediates (as cited in the patent background and comparative example).

value_carriers.name: 威远嘧菌酯原药 / 制剂制造工艺线（禾媄·威远多彩候选；映射未确认）
value_carriers.description: Public formulation brands and a 500 t/a azoxystrobin workshop capacity narrative exist. Spec describes the catalytic process, but no official disclosure reviewed names ZL202011377891.4 / CN112403514B as the exact process run on the commercial line. Pre-filing 2012 TC registration shows product existence long before this filing.

gaps.description: No public regulated disclosure, EIA text, license schedule, or official Weiyuan process document reviewed names ZL202011377891.4 / CN112403514B as implemented on the commercial azoxystrobin line. Spec claim language ≠ E3. Pre-filing 2012 TC registration (PD20121486) and formulation brands must not be inherited as mapping for this 2020 process patent.

gaps.description: Formulation brands and 500 t/a workshop capacity are public at enterprise/product layer, but deployment/usage scale cannot be inherited by this exact patent without an exact-patent → carrier link.
needed_evidence: Independent verification that commercial batches use the claimed catalyst system
Customer or regulator implementation proof matching claimed catalysis

gaps.description: No public evidence attributes cost/energy savings, yield gains, or revenue increment specifically to ZL202011377891.4. Product and capacity narratives emphasize azoxystrobin brands/lines, not this grant number.
needed_evidence: Audited incremental value tied to this patent

gaps.description: Patent asserts milder conditions and higher intermediate yields vs DABCO comparative example; independent reproducible plant-scale benchmarks for THIS claim set were not collected in this ordinary cold start.
needed_evidence: Claim-coverage comparison vs peer azoxystrobin process patents
Third-party evaluation of tetramethyl-diamine/sulfone catalysis claims

notes: Ordinary (non-textbook) CN chemical-industry invention cold-start — mid-tier agrochemical firm (Hebei Veyong), process patent, not software/mechanical samples already done, not BYD/Huawei/award-star. Deliberately stops at R0: product/capacity E2 exists; 2012 TC registration pre-dates 2020-11-30 filing (申请日前产品/登记≈他案); no official E3 naming this grant; carrier_type=process (chemical). Unknown ≠ 0. Formal methodology V0.7 / schema 1.0; V0.8 not adopted; no Counterfactual experimental schema.
